about_the_game:
Speed through sprawling, perilous landscapes, armed to the teeth with an arsenal of powerful weapons and game-changing power-ups including supercharged jumps and adrenaline-pumping nitro boosts. The story unfolds as you master various cars, each with its own set of unique abilities, propelling you through epic war zones. But beware — relentless machines, towering robots, and hostile vehicles will hunt you down at every turn, determined to halt your advance and bring your mission to a screeching halt! 

The Anarchy Road Demo takes you through the first 4 levels of the game.
Level 1 - One of our heroes, Rondo, must escape a city that is under attack by a technically advanced foe!
Level 2 - The escape continues as things amp up. Rondo must evade robotic motorcycle gangs and swarms of robots while driving at an insane speed.
Level 3 - Rondo must make his way through a collapsing city but finds even then he not out of danger.
Level 4 - A new hero and a new car are revealed. Latchkey and his car "The Tarantula" must make their way through a fast curvy environment full of danger.

We hope you enjoy this demo! There is a lot more content coming in the final release due out this year!

Please note, some features have been disabled from the demo, such as, but not limited to- split-screen, difficulty settings, localization, options settings and achievements. Icons for controllers currently only display keyboard and Xbox. Duel shock controller to be fully supported soon. 

Our aim is to add insane surprises to each level. In the upcoming full release we have giant boss battles, driving under moving trains, jumping off of rooftops, racing through active war-zones and more! Wishlist and stay tuned for more action to come!

name: Anarchy Road Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB / GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon R7 370 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080 / AMD Radeon 5700X
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Fast Speeds, Big Explosions, even Bigger Bosses and action throughout! Anarchy Road is a Post-Apocalyptic action driving game where our 4 heroes (2 in Demo) must race against the clock, battle bosses, while blasting enemies and dodging traps in order to survive to the explosive end!
